synopsis: Applied Intuition HIL is listed as a commercial hardware-in-the-loop offering in Chapter 11 and is also named among the glossary’s examples of in-the-loop tools [f9244, f8655, f16038]. The evidence listed for this tool is on-road, leaving its applicability to heavy off-road validation unestablished by the supplied facts [f9246]. Its interfaces are vendor-specific [f9247]. No public price or latest release was found, leaving procurement cost and release currency unresolved [f9248, f9249].

relations.note: Chapter 11 identifies the glossary-listed tool specifically as a hardware-in-the-loop offering.
Chapter 11 adds commercial status to the tools named in the glossary.
Chapter 11 specifies vendor-specific interfaces for three glossary-listed HIL tools.
The listed evidence for the HIL offering is restricted to on-road applications.
